patthana23.51:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.51:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.51:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattikanahīnattike sanidassanattikahīnattikaṃ
